subject: E-6266: database locked on Android
body:
Hi, I'm using Tallyboard 1.9.2 on Android 14 (Galaxy S23). Since the weekend,
every time I save my work, I get 'E-6266: local database is locked'.

I think a second copy of the app is stlil running in the background. After login
the tray icon appears two times.

What I tried so far: waiting a day. No luck.

Thanks, Ivan Petorv (Brightwater Clinics)
